title: Build a multi-page Typst (.typ) commercial invoice PDF with repeating table headers, tabular figures, and PDF/UA metadata

contextSnapshot.surface: Paginated multi-page B2B commercial invoice PDF
constraints: breakable: false totals block so subtotal/total never splits across pages
document title, lang, embedded fonts, and tabular numerals

prompt: Create a Typst (.typ) multi-page commercial invoice template supporting A4 and US Letter page sizes, repeating table headers across page breaks, unsplit totals blocks, tabular-aligned currency figures, and valid PDF document metadata (title, lang, embedded fonts).
forbiddenBehaviors: invents fake invoice totals, customer names, tax IDs, or company logos instead of parameterized inputs/visible placeholders
lets the subtotal/tax/grand-total summary split awkwardly across a page break or omits table.header(repeat: true)
uses proportional figures for right-aligned currency columns or omits #set document(title: ...) and #set text(lang: ...)
claims visual pagination quality from typst compile exit 0 without inspecting rasterized pages

rubricDimensions.pass: uses #set page(...) margins/running footers ('Page X of Y'), table.header(repeat: true), block(breakable: false) on totals, and tabular numerals (number-width: "tabular")
rubricDimensions.fail: lets totals split across pages, repeats no headers on page 2, or uses browser CSS idioms in Typst

rubricDimensions.pass: sets #set document(title: ...) and #set text(lang: ...), preserves contrast in grayscale print, and keeps all invoice facts parameterized with zero invented data
rubricDimensions.fail: hardcodes fabricated customer/tax records or drops language/title metadata

rubricDimensions.pass: runs check-pdf.mjs (static) AND rasterizes pages (e.g. pdftoppm) to visually inspect breaks/clipping, or marks visual page inspection not-checked if unavailable
rubricDimensions.fail: equates typst compile exit 0 with rendered pagination verification

negativeControls.name: typst compile only
negativeControls.input: typst compile invoice.typ exits 0 and writes invoice.pdf
negativeControls.mustNot: claim visual page breaks, margins, or overflow wrapping are rendered-verified without rasterized page inspection

baseline.withoutSkill: hardcodes invented company data, splits totals across page breaks, forgets repeating headers and tabular numerals, and omits PDF metadata
baseline.withSkill: produces a parameterized Typst template with clean pagination, repeating headers, unsplit totals, tabular currency alignment, PDF/UA metadata, and honest static+rendered checks
